trigger_condition: search term contains LIKE wildcard characters % or _
potential_consequence: Caller-controlled wildcards widen or narrow result set unexpectedly

trigger_condition: from parameter is a date after the to parameter
guard_snippet: if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();
potential_consequence: Inverted range silently returns empty page with no error signal to caller

trigger_condition: status value has leading or trailing whitespace
potential_consequence: UPPER(" UPCOMING") != UPPER("UPCOMING"); filter silently returns zero results

trigger_condition: from or to filter applied and a conference has null startDate
guard_snippet: (c.startDate IS NULL OR c.startDate >= :from) AND (c.startDate IS NULL OR c.startDate <= :to)
potential_consequence: Conferences with no startDate silently vanish from results whenever any date filter is active

trigger_condition: any filter changes while page state is greater than 0
guard_snippet: merge both effects: reset page inside the fetch effect before calling getConferences, or skip fetch until page settles
potential_consequence: Spurious fetch fires with new filter + stale page number before page resets to 0

trigger_condition: filter changes faster than prior fetch resolves (e.g. rapid keystrokes)
guard_snippet: const controller = new AbortController(); fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal }); return () => controller.abort();
potential_consequence: Stale slow response overwrites newer fast response; wrong result set shown

trigger_condition: user types continuously in the search input
guard_snippet: debounce setSearch update: useEffect with setTimeout on raw input value, clear on next keystroke
potential_consequence: One API call fired per keystroke; server flooded; rapid inflight requests compound race condition

trigger_condition: user sets fromDate to a date later than toDate
guard_snippet: if (fromDate && toDate && fromDate > toDate) show validation message; omit or swap params
potential_consequence: Inverted range silently returns empty grid; user has no indication the input is invalid
